host_bandwidth.method: torch .to(device) / .cpu() on a contiguous bfloat16 buffer, host-side perf_counter, best and median of N reps after one warm copy. Bounds the cross-vendor P/D KV handoff: GPU->host->NPU is two copies and the GPU leg is not measurable on this machine.

memory.method: bisected torch.empty(bfloat16) on one PE, 0.25 GB resolution
memory.note: one allocation, not the PE's total budget: the runtime may refuse a single block smaller than the sum of several
